summary: SIMPLE is the collective name for the IETF specifications covering instant messaging and presence over the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP). This document is a guide to that large family. It sorts the specifications into categories, explains what each is for, and shows how they relate to one another.

eli5.summary: There are lots of rule books for sending chat messages and showing who is online. This one is a map of the whole shelf, telling you which book does what.

questions: what is simple sip instant messaging and presence
